title: Seconds to a clock 時間換算
description: Read a nonnegative integer number of seconds. Convert it into hours, minutes, and seconds. Print HH:MM:SS, with each field at least two digits wide. Hours may exceed 23.
hints: Use int(input()), //, and % (整數除法、餘數).
Hours = total // 3600; minutes = total % 3600 // 60.
Seconds = total % 60. Format each field with :02d.
solution:
total_seconds = int(input())
hours = total_seconds // 3600
minutes = total_seconds % 3600 // 60
seconds = total_seconds % 60
print(f"{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}:{seconds:02d}")

title: Shopping total 購物總額
description: Read a unit price (float) on the first line and a quantity (integer) on the second. Print Total: followed immediately by their product to exactly two decimal places.
hints: Use float(input()) and int(input()).
Multiply price by quantity.
Use print(f"Total:{total:.2f}").
solution:
price = float(input())
quantity = int(input())
total = price * quantity
print(f"Total:{total:.2f}")

title: Calculate BMI 身體質量指數
description: Read weight in kilograms and height in METERS, one per line. Height is positive. Print BMI: followed immediately by weight / height², rounded to two decimal places.
hints: Read both values with float(input()).
Use ** 2 for the square (次方).
Use an f-string with :.2f.
solution:
weight = float(input())
height = float(input())
bmi = weight / height ** 2
print(f"BMI:{bmi:.2f}")

title: Grade classification 成績分級
description: Read a numeric score. Scores outside 0–100 print Invalid score. Otherwise print A for 90–100, B for 80–<90, C for 70–<80, D for 60–<70, and F below 60. Print one line only.
hints: Use float(input()) and if / elif / else (條件判斷).
Reject scores outside the valid range first.
Test thresholds from highest to lowest using >=.

title: Bank login 銀行登入
description: The stored account is the STRING 00123, the password is pw123, and the balance is 5000. Read the account and password on separate lines. When both match, print Login successful and then Balance:5000 on the next line. Otherwise print Incorrect account or password. including the period.
hints: Use input() without int() to preserve leading zeros.
Combine two equality comparisons with and.
The success branch prints two lines; the failure branch prints one.
solution:
account = "00123"
password = "pw123"
balance = 5000

entered_account = input()
entered_password = input()

if entered_account == account and entered_password == password:
    print("Login successful")
    print(f"Balance:{balance}")
else:
    print("Incorrect account or password.")

title: Leap year 閏年判斷
description: Read a positive year. A leap year is divisible by 400, or divisible by 4 but not by 100. Print YEAR is a leap year or YEAR is a common year, replacing YEAR with the input.
hints: Use % to test divisibility (整除).
Combine conditions with and / or.
year % 400 == 0 or (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0).

Read an integer choice. For choices 1–6, read a float value on the next line and print the converted number to four decimal places. Use F = C × 9/5 + 32, 1 km = 0.6214 mi, and 1 kg = 2.2046 lb; reverse conversions divide by the factor. For any other choice, print Invalid option. and do not read a value. The menu is part of the required output.
hints: Use print(), int(input()), float(input()), and if / elif / else.
Read the value only after checking that the choice is valid.
Reverse Fahrenheit with (value - 32) * 5 / 9; print using :.4f.

title: BMI categories BMI 分類
description: Read weight in kilograms and height in CENTIMETERS on separate lines. If either is <= 0, print Invalid input. Otherwise print BMI: and the BMI to two decimal places, then the category on a second line. Classify using the unrounded BMI: <18.5 Underweight; <24 Normal; <27 Overweight; otherwise Obese.
hints: Use float(), if / elif, and **.
Convert centimeters to meters before squaring.
Calculate the category before rounding; formatting changes only the displayed value.

title: Choose a season 季節判斷
description: Read an integer month. Print Spring for 3–5, Summer for 6–8, Autumn for 9–11, Winter for 12, 1, or 2. Other integers print Invalid month.
hints: Use match / case or if / elif.
Group the three months belonging to each season.
In match, use case 3 | 4 | 5: and case _: for invalid input.
solution:
month = int(input())
match month:
    case 3 | 4 | 5:
        print("Spring")
    case 6 | 7 | 8:
        print("Summer")
    case 9 | 10 | 11:
        print("Autumn")
    case 12 | 1 | 2:
        print("Winter")
    case _:
        print("Invalid month")

title: Odd numbers 奇數
description: Read positive integers a and b on ONE line, with a < b. Print the odd integers in [a, b] in ascending order. Put one space AFTER EVERY number, including the last, then a newline.
hints: Use map(int, input().split()) and range().
If a is even, increase the starting value by 1; use step 2.
Use range(start, b + 1, 2), print(value, end=" "), then print().

title: Multiples: scan 倍數逐一檢查
description: Read a b c on ONE line, with 0 < a < c < b. Print all multiples of c in [a, b], ascending. Put one space after EACH number, including the last, then a newline. Scan every integer and test divisibility.
hints: Use range() and % (餘數).
Visit every integer from a through b; keep values whose remainder modulo c is zero.
Use range(a, b + 1) and print(value, end=" "), then print().

title: Multiples: step 倍數步進
description: Read a b c on ONE line, with 0 < a < c < b. Print all multiples of c in [a, b], ascending. Put one space after EACH number, including the last, then a newline. Step directly from one multiple to the next.
hints: Use // and range(start, stop, step).
The first multiple at least a is ((a + c - 1) // c) * c.
Start at that multiple and step by c through b inclusive; print a trailing space and final newline.

title: Inclusive sum 加總 · for
description: Read positive integers a b on one line, with a < b. Use a for loop to sum every integer from a through b INCLUSIVE. Print only the sum and a newline.
hints: Use an accumulator (累加器) initialized to 0.
Use range(a, b + 1).
Add the current value to the total each iteration; print the total after the loop.

title: Inclusive sum 加總 · while
description: Read positive integers a b on one line, with a < b. Use a while loop to sum every integer from a through b INCLUSIVE. Print only the sum and a newline.
hints: Use an accumulator (累加器) initialized to 0.
Use a counter starting at a, with counter <= b.
Add the current value to the total each iteration; print the total after the loop.
solution:
a, b = map(int, input().split())
if 0 < a < b:
    total = 0
    value = a
    while value <= b:
        total += value
        value += 1
    print(total)

title: Factorial threshold 階乘
description: Read a nonnegative integer N. Find the smallest POSITIVE integer k such that k! is strictly GREATER than N. Print k, not k!. For N = 7, print 4 because 3! = 6 and 4! = 24. Use a while loop.
hints: Use a running product (累乘器) and a while loop.
Start k = 1 and factorial = 1. Continue while factorial <= N.
Each iteration increments k first, then multiplies factorial by k. Print k.
solution:
number = int(input())
k = 1
factorial = 1
while factorial <= number:
    k += 1
    factorial *= k
print(k)

title: Triangle with while 巢狀 while
description: Read a nonnegative integer n. Row i has i stars and no leading spaces. Use nested while loops only. Every printed row ends with a newline and has NO trailing spaces. If n = 0, print nothing.
hints: Use nested while loops (巢狀迴圈).
Track the row number; determine leading spaces and stars separately.
Row i has i stars and no leading spaces. Use nested while loops only. Print a newline after each row.
solution:
n = int(input())
i = 1
while i <= n:
    j = 1
    while j <= i:
        print("*", end="")
        j += 1
    print()
    i += 1

title: Class & grade statistics 班級統計
description:
Use ONLY while loops. Read class names until the string 999. For each class, read one numeric score per line until 111. Scores are 0–100. Count each entered class, including an empty one.
After each class print five lines: Class:NAME, Total:NUMBER, Average:NUMBER, Highest:NUMBER, Lowest:NUMBER. Show all numbers to two decimal places. An empty class has Total:0.00 and N/A for the other three statistics.
At the end print Classes:COUNT, Grade average:NUMBER, Grade highest:NUMBER, Grade lowest:NUMBER. Compute the grade average over ALL STUDENTS, not class averages. If no students were entered, use N/A for all three grade statistics. Sentinels are never scores. Do not print prompts or blank separator lines.
hints: Use nested while loops, input(), float(), and counters (計數器).
Reset class totals/counts for each class. Keep separate grade totals/counts outside the outer loop.
Initialize highest and lowest to None. Check each sentinel before updating statistics.
Use total / count only when count > 0; format with :.2f. Empty classes still increase the class count.
solution:
class_count = 0
all_count = 0
all_total = 0.0
all_highest = None
all_lowest = None

while True:
    class_name = input()
    if class_name == "999":
        break

    class_count += 1
    count = 0
    total = 0.0
    highest = None
    lowest = None

    while True:
        score = float(input())
        if score == 111:
            break

        count += 1
        total += score
        if count == 1:
            highest = score
            lowest = score
        else:
            if score > highest:
                highest = score
            if score < lowest:
                lowest = score

        all_count += 1
        all_total += score
        if all_count == 1:
            all_highest = score
            all_lowest = score
        else:
            if score > all_highest:
                all_highest = score
            if score < all_lowest:
                all_lowest = score

    print(f"Class:{class_name}")
    print(f"Total:{total:.2f}")
    if count > 0:
        print(f"Average:{total / count:.2f}")
        print(f"Highest:{highest:.2f}")
        print(f"Lowest:{lowest:.2f}")
    else:
        print("Average:N/A")
        print("Highest:N/A")
        print("Lowest:N/A")

print(f"Classes:{class_count}")
if all_count > 0:
    print(f"Grade average:{all_total / all_count:.2f}")
    print(f"Grade highest:{all_highest:.2f}")
    print(f"Grade lowest:{all_lowest:.2f}")
else:
    print("Grade average:N/A")
    print("Grade highest:N/A")
    print("Grade lowest:N/A")

title: Second distinct score 第二高相異成績
